title: Access to a file that looks like a password store
kql: event.category:"file" and event.type:"access" and (file.path:*passwords* and file.path:*.txt)

title: DNS query for a reserved, non-resolving TLD
kql: event.category:"network" and event.type:"protocol" and (dns.question.name:*.invalid or dns.question.name:*.test or dns.question.name:*.example)

title: Linux host and identity discovery commands
kql: host.os.type:"linux" and event.category:"process" and event.type:"start" and (process.executable:*/id or (process.executable:*/uname and process.command_line:*\ -a*) or (process.executable:*/getent and process.command_line:*sudo*))

title: XDG autostart entry created
kql: host.os.type:"linux" and event.category:"file" and event.type:"creation" and ((file.path:*/.config/autostart/* or file.path:*/etc/xdg/autostart/*) and file.path:*.desktop)

title: Microsoft Defender detected or quarantined malware
kql: host.os.type:"windows" and winlog.channel:"Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational" and (event.code:"1116" or event.code:"1117")

title: Local administrators group enumeration with net.exe
kql: host.os.type:"windows" and event.category:"process" and event.type:"start" and ((process.executable:*\\net.exe or process.executable:*\\net1.exe) and (process.command_line:*localgroup* and process.command_line:*administrators*))

title: PowerShell started with an encoded command
kql: host.os.type:"windows" and event.category:"process" and event.type:"start" and ((process.executable:*\\powershell.exe or process.executable:*\\pwsh.exe) and (process.command_line:*\ -EncodedCommand\ * or process.command_line:*\ /EncodedCommand\ * or process.command_line:*\ -enc\ * or process.command_line:*\ /enc\ * or process.command_line:*\ -ec\ * or process.command_line:*\ /ec\ *))

title: New value under a user Run key
kql: host.os.type:"windows" and event.category:"registry" and (registry.path:*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\* and not (registry.data.strings:*\\Microsoft\\OneDrive\\OneDrive.exe* and registry.data.strings:*/background*))

title: Scheduled task created with schtasks.exe
kql: host.os.type:"windows" and event.category:"process" and event.type:"start" and (process.executable:*\\schtasks.exe and (process.command_line:*-create* or process.command_line:*/create*))

title: Whoami /all execution
kql: host.os.type:"windows" and event.category:"process" and event.type:"start" and (process.executable:*\\whoami.exe and process.command_line:*/all*)
